column3: The Hebrew says “his house”; BSB specifies “his own palace.”
The Hebrew says “built” and repeats Solomon’s name; BSB says “rebuilt” and uses “him.”
The Hebrew says Solomon became strong against Hamath-zobah; BSB expresses this as capturing it.
The Hebrew separately names cities for horsemen and repeats desire and desired; BSB uses cities for horses and whatever he desired.
The Hebrew says the Israelites did not destroy them; BSB says they were unable to destroy them.
The Hebrew explicitly says these officials ruled over the people; BSB calls them supervisors without expressing that object.
The Hebrew gives the daily requirement for offering according to Moses’ command; BSB supplies the clause “He observed.”
The Hebrew coordinates “every matter” and “the treasuries”; BSB makes the treasuries the subject of the matters concerned.
The Hebrew begins with until the day the foundation was laid and then until completion; BSB begins from that day.
The Hebrew says Hiram sent ships and servants who knew the sea through his servants; BSB specifies captains and experienced crews.
